desktop.link.detail.runtimeDifferent: The active and stored states on {{system}} do not demonstrably match. Check operation before using the permission.
desktop.link.externalHelp: A successful app connection does not confirm other accounts. These items explicitly remain open. The assistant sends no test messages or device commands between systems.
desktop.link.detail.external.accounts: Check the accounts actually used by Z2M and the bridge on the servers. Additional users are optional; existing accounts can be used.
desktop.link.detail.external.rights: Z2M accounts and, for separate brokers, bridge accounts need read/write access to z2ma/mesh/#. Keep existing Z2M permissions.
desktop.link.detail.external.bridge: Check whether transport for z2ma/mesh/# already exists in both directions. An additional bridge must not create a loop.
desktop.link.detail.bridgeUnneeded: The project assignment uses the same broker endpoint. No additional broker bridge is required between these two systems.
desktop.link.detail.external.roundTrip: An end-to-end test using the actual extensions has not been performed. Carry it out separately after setup.
desktop.link.suggestionHelp: These are supplementary examples for Mosquitto with password and ACL files, not complete replacement files. Accounts, server access and existing configuration must be checked first. With Dynamic Security, the administrator manages the corresponding users and roles there; this app does not configure them yet.
desktop.link.topology.shared: Shared broker endpoint: no additional bridge. Check mesh permissions for both Z2M accounts, even when they use the same broker.
desktop.link.topology.separate: Different broker endpoints: the template connects the first system's broker to the second system's broker. One bridge with both directions is enough. Check existing bridges and address aliases; plan a loop-free topology for multiple brokers. The template uses the second broker's TLS mode configured in the app. Unencrypted connections also transmit credentials in plain text.
desktop.link.noSuggestions: First correct base topics and assignments. No configuration excerpts are generated for ambiguous systems.
desktop.link.snippet.bridge: {{broker}}: one bridge to the second broker
desktop.link.snippetHelp.peers: Use partner permissions in step 3. This excerpt adds the selected partner and preserves other local permissions. It is not a complete automation draft and must not replace the configuration.
desktop.link.snippetHelp.acl: Replace REPLACE_Z2M_USER with the actual Z2M username; add the topic to its existing ACL section. On a shared broker this applies to both Z2M accounts. REPLACE_BRIDGE_USER denotes the bridge account on this broker. Keep existing permissions and do not replace a password file.
desktop.link.snippetHelp.bridge: Configure only on the first system's broker. REPLACE_LOCAL_* belongs to this broker and REPLACE_REMOTE_* to the second. Replace all placeholders on the server and protect the file from other users. For TLS, set the CA path and, if required, client certificates on that server; imported app certificates are not transferred. Do not add another reverse bridge or a loop.
desktop.link.copyHelp: After selecting, copy with Ctrl+C. The app does not read passwords from the credential vault for this.
desktop.link.followup.backup: Back up the existing broker configuration and project. Keep existing accounts, rules and topic permissions.
desktop.link.followup.placeholders: An administrator reviews the suggestions and replaces all placeholders on the affected servers. Existing accounts can be reused.
desktop.link.followup.apply: Reload the additional broker settings or deliberately restart the service as appropriate for the installed Mosquitto version. This app does not do that.
desktop.link.followup.transfer: Add partner permissions for both systems in step 3 and save the project. Account for existing rules in step 5, check in step 7 and transfer deliberately in step 8. Then activate the receiving operation separately.
desktop.link.followup.test: Then separately test cooperation using the actual Z2M extensions. This assistant does not confirm a device command or turn on an automation.
